phase: Phase 2 — Claim Maintenance product spine (Compound CEO mandate)

claim_id.note: Short-form ID per registry (e.g. CL-1). Not globally unique across registries — would need registry_id + id for global uniqueness.

subject.phase2_required: Organisation whose claim is being maintained
subject.note: At registry level, not per-artifact. A claim artifact inherits its subject from the registry.

claim_text.note: Verbatim capture per spec §1.5. Also artifact.type classifies it.

state.note: 4-state evidence model (v0.2). Phase 2's 12-state lifecycle model is a different scope — see state machine analysis below.

dependencies.phase2_required: What other claims/records this claim depends on
dependencies.note: No dependency graph between claims exists in the v0.2 artifact schema.

source_rights.phase2_required: Rights to read and record the source
source_rights.current_location: Implicit in spec §1.3 (public claims only). artifact.sources lists URLs.
source_rights.note: Sources are listed as URLs. No explicit rights/licence declaration per source. Spec §1.3 constrains to public surfaces but no per-source rights field.

extractor.phase2_required: How the claim was extracted from the source
extractor.current_location: artifact.method (for measurement). Capture method is described in spec §6.3.1.
extractor.note: method field describes the measurement method. The capture/extractor (how text was pulled from HTML) is described in spec but not recorded per-artifact.

prior_reads.phase2_required: History of previous reads with hashes
prior_reads.note: observed_changes records hash differences between reads. Full prior read history (every read's hash + timestamp) is not kept — only observed changes.

next_read.phase2_required: When the next scheduled read is
next_read.note: Scheduler tracks day-7/30/90 checks with due dates. Spec requires every claim to publish next_read_utc.

changed_dependencies.phase2_required: Dependencies that changed since last read
changed_dependencies.current_location: observed_changes at the source level. Not at a dependency level.
changed_dependencies.note: Without a dependency graph (field 5), changed_dependencies cannot be tracked.

affected_products.note: No product dependency tracking in the claim artifact.

recheck_plan.phase2_required: How and when to recheck the claim
recheck_plan.current_location: Scheduler: day-7/30/90 after created. spec §1.1 continuous requirement.
recheck_plan.note: Recheck schedule exists at the scheduler level (day-7/30/90). No per-claim recheck plan beyond the uniform schedule.

correction_pointer.phase2_required: Link to correction if one exists
correction_pointer.current_location: Corrections ledger at /api/corrections (89 entries). Cross-reference by ID (e.g. C-2026-0930-11 referenced in artifact note).
correction_pointer.note: Corrections exist as a separate ledger. Cross-references appear in note fields (e.g. 'C-2026-0930-11') but there is no formal correction_pointer field linking a claim to its corrections.

evidence_refs.note: Sources and measurement data serve as evidence refs. Multiple evidence channels: source URLs, measurement results, signed per-item rows.

delivery_refs.phase2_required: References to deliveries of this claim to buyers/users
delivery_refs.note: No delivery tracking in the claim artifact. Revenue SKU counts exist separately but are not linked to individual claims.

billing_state.phase2_required: Whether this claim is billed/delivered/awaiting payment
billing_state.current_location: Revenue API (/api/revenue) tracks SKU counts. Not linked to individual claims.
billing_state.note: Revenue is tracked at SKU level (issuance/proofs/licences). No per-claim billing state.

v0_2_model.scope: Claim evidence state — is there a measurement against public evidence?
v0_2_model.philosophy: 4 states, only 4, MUST NOT invent a fifth (spec §4)

phase2_model.scope: Full claim lifecycle — registration through delivery and maintenance
phase2_model.philosophy: 12-state lifecycle with dependency tracking and delivery

state_machine_analysis.assessment: These are different scopes. v0.2's 4-state model is about evidence availability. Phase 2's 12-state model is about lifecycle management. v0.3 would need to either (a) extend the 4-state evidence model with lifecycle metadata fields, or (b) define a separate lifecycle state machine alongside it. Option (a) preserves v0.2's 'there are 4 and only 4' discipline while adding lifecycle as metadata.

recommendation.for_v03: Extend v0.2's 4-state evidence model with lifecycle metadata fields (dependencies, source_rights, changed_dependencies, affected_products, correction_pointer, delivery_refs, billing_state) rather than replacing the state machine. The 4-state model is the load-bearing honesty discipline — adding states would weaken it. Lifecycle states can be a separate orthogonal dimension.
quick_wins: correction_pointer (formalize the cross-references already in note fields)
prior_reads (keep full read history, not just observed changes)

honesty_note: This is a schema readiness assessment against the Phase 2 mandate requirements. It does not write code, change the spec, or publish anything. The v0.2 spec's 4-state model is a deliberate design choice (spec §4: 'There are four, there are only four') — the gap is lifecycle metadata, not a flaw in the evidence model.
